metadata.title: Controls — Nebula
metadata.description: Default buttons, pointer and motion, controllers and remapping.

page.paragraph_2: Default buttons, pointer and motion, controllers and remapping.

defaults.paragraph_1: Keyboard and mouse, controllers and the Wii Remote with Nunchuk work at the same time. The controller layout follows the Switch release.
defaults.column_8: Jump in play, back in menus
defaults.cell_11: Left Shift, Right Shift, right mouse button
defaults.cell_28: X, Y, ZR, shake the controller
defaults.cell_38: D-pad; right stick while the gyro points
defaults.cell_43: Gyro; right stick when the gyro is off
defaults.paragraph_2: On controllers, B / Circle is jump during play and Back in menus. Use LB / L / L1 to shoot Star Bits.

motion.item_1: The mouse moves the pointer. On Xbox controllers, use the right stick.
motion.item_2: PlayStation, Switch and Steam controllers point with the gyro. With the gyro off, the right stick points.
motion.item_3: The recenter button moves the pointer to the middle of the screen.
motion.item_4: Shake a controller with motion sensors to spin, or press a spin button.
motion.item_5: Tilt the controller to steer the Star Ball and Ray Surfing. Keyboards and Xbox controllers steer with movement.
motion.item_6: Pointer speed, gyro sensitivity, dead zones and vibration are on the CONTROLS page.
motion.item_7: PlayStation controllers also point with the touchpad, and Steam controllers with the right trackpad.

devices.cell_1: USB, Bluetooth or the Xbox Wireless Adapter.
devices.cell_2: DualShock 4, DualSense and DualSense Edge over USB or Bluetooth, with gyro and touchpad.
devices.cell_3: USB or Bluetooth, with gyro and HD Rumble.
devices.cell_4: USB only. On Windows, needs the WinUSB driver on its second USB interface (for example with Zadig).
devices.cell_5: A left and a right half pair as one controller.
devices.cell_6: Steam Deck controls, Steam Controller (2015) by USB or receiver, Steam Controller (2026) by USB, Bluetooth or receiver.
devices.cell_8: Any USB or Bluetooth controller, without vibration.
devices.cell_9: Bluetooth or a Mayflash DolphinBar on Windows, DolphinBar on Android. Points at a sensor bar, or by motion with Wii MotionPlus.

remapping.paragraph_1: On the CONTROLS page, choose a device, then a Wii input. Each Wii input takes up to four inputs. Controls are saved per controller family.
remapping.paragraph_2: Button icons on the GENERAL page sets one button style for every controller.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
